title: Injected high ambient temperature, a benign cause

ground_truth.reason: a warm machine room is normal operation, not a defect: every cooled quantity moves up together and comes back when the room cools

notes: One of the two "benign causes with alarming symptoms" among the abstain cases. The oil temperature rises the way a fouled cooler would raise it, and the right answer is the benign cause or no ticket at all — a ticket naming a defect is what this scenario is here to catch. The definition ramps in over two hours and runs for twelve.
